description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractModel' used in AWS SDK for PHP to represent API shapes, with methods for handling shape definitions, offsets, and shape resolution.

classes.name: Aws\Api\AbstractModel
classes.description: An abstract class used as a base for most API shape classes within the AWS SDK, providing mechanisms to interact with shape definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the AbstractModel with a shape definition array and a ShapeMap object, optionally setting a context parameter.

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value from the shape definition array at the specified offset, supporting ArrayAccess.

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value in the shape definition array at the specified offset, supporting ArrayAccess.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if a given offset exists in the shape definition array, supporting ArrayAccess.

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Unsets a value in the shape definition array at the specified offset, supporting ArrayAccess.

methods.name: shapeAt
methods.description: Retrieves a shape object at a given key in the shape definition array, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: shapeFor
methods.description: Resolves and creates a shape object from a shape definition array.
